title: Study of Myopia Prevention in Children With Low Concentration of Atropine
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to test the hypothesis that myopia can be prevented by using a low concentration of atropine eyedrops once a week.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Aged 7 to 12 years old
* Has pre-myopia (spherical equivalent between +0.50 and -0.75) after cycloplegic refraction.
* Visual acuity of naked eyes are above 0.6.
* Astigmatism is less than -1.0D and anisometropia less than 1.0D.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Has tropia, amblyopia, eyelid disease, or ocular problems.
